en.summary: This commit fixes a configuration-sensitive LSU ordering bug by removing the unrelated SIMD_COUNT > 1 guard from the LSU collector-pinning rule.
why_it_counts: The patch changes active operand-collector scheduling behavior in a core RTL module.
It removes a spurious configuration predicate that disabled memory-order serialization in legal scalar or low-SIMD configurations.
The commit comment explicitly states that LSU cannot handle out-of-order LD/ST instructions.
disqualifiers: The VX_opc_unit.sv hunk is a syntax cleanup and does not materially affect the classification.
evidence: In VX_operands.sv, the EX_LSU collector-selection rule is moved out from under the combined NUM_OPCS > 1 && SIMD_COUNT > 1 condition.
The LSU comment is updated to say that LSU cannot handle out-of-order LD/ST instructions and should use the same collector.
The non-VX_operands change is just replacing an explicit OR assignment with |= in VX_opc_unit.sv.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Serialization rules for ordered memory traffic should depend on whether multiple pre-LSU collectors exist, not on an unrelated SIMD width or lane-count setting. If a design accidentally ties the rule to vector width, scalar or reduced-width configurations can silently lose the ordering constraint even though multiple collectors still exist.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: configuration guard for ordered LSU collector serialization
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Multiple operand collectors exist, but an unrelated configuration such as SIMD width, lane grouping, or packet width disables the LSU serialization rule.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Reintroduce a spurious configuration predicate so LSU collector pinning is bypassed in scalar or reduced-width modes.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: add unrelated config guard around ordering rule
portability_notes: Use any configuration knob that should not logically control memory ordering, such as vector width, lane packing, or operand packet width.
The injected bug should preserve the dedicated collector behavior in some configs and disable it in others.
This bug is only meaningful if the target DUT still has more than one eligible pre-LSU queue.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the rule that forces ordered LSU operations into one collector or queue.
Wrap that rule with an extra condition based on an unrelated configuration knob so it does not run in a scalar or reduced-width setup.
Leave the rest of the collector arbitration unchanged.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix moves the EX_LSU collector-pinning rule out of the SIMD_COUNT > 1 condition, while leaving the WCTL-specific SFU rule under the SIMD-dependent guard.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Put the EX_LSU condition back under the combined NUM_OPCS > 1 && SIMD_COUNT > 1 guard, or add an equivalent unrelated configuration gate.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Scalar or low-SIMD configurations can again send LSU requests through multiple collectors, allowing out-of-order memory issue even though multi-collector hardware is still present.
evidence_for_injection: The pre-fix code tied both WCTL and LSU pinning to the same SIMD_COUNT > 1 predicate.
The fix separates LSU from that predicate but keeps the SFU/WCTL rule under it.
The commit comment explicitly identifies out-of-order LD/ST as the problem.
notes: A one-line mutation that adds the extra guard back is the most faithful reinjection.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了一个与配置相关的 LSU 顺序性错误：它把 LSU collector 固定规则从无关的 SIMD_COUNT > 1 条件中移了出来。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改了核心 RTL 模块中的有效操作数 collector 调度行为。
它删除了一个错误的配置条件，该条件会在合法的标量或低 SIMD 配置下关闭内存顺序串行化。
提交中的注释明确指出 LSU 无法处理乱序 LD/ST 指令。
disqualifiers: VX_opc_unit.sv 的 hunk 只是语法清理，不影响该分类判断。
evidence: 在 VX_operands.sv 中，EX_LSU 的 collector 选择规则被移出了 NUM_OPCS > 1 && SIMD_COUNT > 1 的联合条件。
LSU 注释明确写成“LSU cannot handle out of order LD/ST instructions, should use same collector”。
另一个非 VX_operands 的修改只是把显式 OR 赋值改成 |=。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 针对有序内存流量的串行化规则，应该取决于是否存在多个 LSU 前级 collector，而不应取决于无关的 SIMD 宽度或 lane 数。如果设计把这条规则错误地绑定到向量宽度，标量或缩窄配置就会静默失去顺序约束，即便多 collector 硬件仍然存在。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 有序 LSU collector 串行化的配置保护条件
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 存在多个操作数 collector，但某个与内存顺序无关的配置项，如 SIMD 宽度、lane 分组或包宽度，错误地关闭了 LSU 串行化规则。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 重新加入一个错误的配置条件，使 LSU collector 固定规则在标量或缩窄模式下被绕过。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 给顺序规则增加无关的配置保护
portability_notes: 可以使用任何本不应控制内存顺序的配置开关，例如向量宽度、lane 打包或操作数包宽度。
注入后的错误应表现为：某些配置保留专用 collector 行为，而另一些配置把它关闭。
只有在目标 DUT 仍有多个可选的 LSU 前级队列时，该故障才有意义。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位强制 LSU 有序操作进入单一 collector 或单一队列的规则。
给该规则额外包上一层无关配置条件，使其在标量或缩窄配置下不生效。
保持其余 collector 仲裁逻辑不变。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: EX_LSU 的 select_opcs collector 选择逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 EX_LSU 的 collector 固定规则从 SIMD_COUNT > 1 条件中独立出来，而把 SFU/WCTL 的专用规则继续保留在 SIMD 相关条件下。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把 EX_LSU 条件重新放回 NUM_OPCS > 1 && SIMD_COUNT > 1 的联合保护下，或加入等价的无关配置条件。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 标量或低 SIMD 配置会再次把 LSU 请求分发到多个 collector，使得即使硬件仍有多 collector，也会出现内存乱序发射。
evidence_for_injection: 修复前，WCTL 与 LSU 的固定规则都被绑在 SIMD_COUNT > 1 条件上。
修复后，LSU 从该条件中分离出来，而 SFU/WCTL 仍保留原有的 SIMD 相关条件。
提交注释明确把问题归因于 LD/ST 乱序。
notes: 最忠实的重新注入方式，是用一行改动把额外保护条件重新加回去。
